scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a building under construction with scaffolding, surrounded by pedestrians and vehicles. The street is paved with concrete and has white markings. A tree stands in front of the building, casting a shadow on the ground. The sky is clear and blue.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building is tall and covered in scaffolding, with a green awning over the entrance. It has multiple levels, with balconies on each floor. The building is made of stone and has a mix of old and new features.
scene_analysis.materials: The building's facade is made of stone, with some parts covered in scaffolding. There are also some metal beams and wooden planks visible.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk, as well as a few bicycles parked near the entrance.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several trees and plants along the sidewalk, including a large palm tree in front of the building.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted around the building, including a parking sign and a directional sign.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are several people walking along the sidewalk, including a group of tourists taking photos.
